graders.title: Exact match
graders.description: Passes when the answer equals the expected value after trimming, case folding and key-order-insensitive JSON normalisation.

expected.description: The value to compare against. The TypeScript grader object carries it here; the Python grade service reads the case reference instead, so a suite that only sets this option compares against the fixture reference on the service.

case_sensitive.description: Skip the case-folding step; JSON normalisation is unchanged.

remove_punctuation.description: Delete ASCII punctuation before comparing; string-only, and fails closed when either side is a structured value.

graders.title: Contains
graders.description: Passes when every listed fragment appears somewhere in the answer, matched case-sensitively as a substring.

fragments.description: Fragments that must all be present. Legacy behaviour kept for compatibility: the Python service stringifies a non-string member instead of failing.

graders.title: Does not contain
graders.description: Passes only when none of the listed fragments appear in the answer.

fragments.description: Forbidden fragments; a non-string member is an invalid option and fails closed.

graders.title: Regex match
graders.description: Passes when the pattern matches the answer, using each language's own regex engine on the portable pattern subset.

pattern.description: Regular expression searched in the answer text; an invalid pattern fails closed.

graders.title: Regex must not match
graders.description: Passes when the pattern does not match the answer, after CRLF and a single trailing newline are normalised away.

pattern.description: Regular expression that must not match; an empty or invalid pattern fails closed.

graders.title: Blocklist
graders.description: Passes when none of the listed terms appear as whole words in the answer, compared case-insensitively.

terms.description: Forbidden terms; word boundaries are pinned lookarounds, not the engine's own word-character rule.

graders.title: JSON schema
graders.description: Passes when the answer satisfies a small JSON-Schema subset covering type, enum, required, properties and items only.

schema.description: The subset schema the answer must satisfy; an unknown type name fails closed.

graders.title: JSON path
graders.description: Passes when the dotted path resolves in the answer and, when equals is set, holds that value.

path.description: Dot-separated path; array steps are numeric indexes.

equals.description: Optional value assertion at the path; comparison is type-strict.

exists.description: Assert only presence (true) or absence (false) of the path, ignoring equals.

graders.title: Tool called
graders.description: Passes when every listed tool appears in the answer's tool calls.

tools.description: Tool names that must all have been called.

graders.title: Tool not called
graders.description: Passes when none of the listed tools appear in the answer's tool calls.

tools.description: Tool names that must not have been called.

graders.title: Tool sequence
graders.description: Passes when the listed tools appear as an ordered subsequence of the tool calls; other calls may sit between them.

tools.description: Tool names in the order they must appear.

graders.title: Tool argument
graders.description: Passes when some call to the named tool carries the argument at path equal to the expected value.

tool.description: Name of the tool call to inspect.

path.description: Dot-separated path inside that call's arguments.

equals.description: Value the argument must equal; comparison is type-strict.

graders.title: HTTP status
graders.description: Passes when the answer's status field equals the expected status code; an answer without a status fails.

status.description: Expected status, read from the answer's status or status_code field.

graders.title: Latency ceiling
graders.description: Passes when the answer's recorded p95 latency is at or under the ceiling; an unmeasured answer fails.

p95_ms.description: Ceiling in milliseconds, compared against the answer's p95_ms or latency_ms field.

graders.title: Cost ceiling
graders.description: Passes when the answer's recorded cost is at or under the ceiling; an unmeasured answer fails.

max_usd.description: Ceiling in US dollars, compared against the answer's cost_usd or total_cost_usd field.

graders.title: Token ceiling
graders.description: Passes when the answer's recorded token count is at or under the ceiling; an unmeasured answer fails.

max_tokens.description: Ceiling in tokens, compared against the answer's tokens or total_tokens field.

graders.title: BLEU score
graders.description: Modified n-gram precision with a brevity penalty against a reference string on a pinned tokenizer, so it is deterministic but not comparable to published sacrebleu numbers.

reference.description: Reference text; the Python service falls back to the case reference when this option is absent.

threshold.description: Score the answer must reach to pass.

graders.title: ROUGE score
graders.description: Unigram or longest-common-subsequence overlap against a reference string on the same pinned tokenizer, so it is deterministic but not comparable to published rouge-score numbers.

reference.description: Reference text; the Python service falls back to the case reference when this option is absent.

rouge_type.description: Unigram overlap or longest common subsequence.

measure.description: Which figure the threshold is applied to.

threshold.description: Score the answer must reach to pass.

graders.title: Context F1
graders.description: Precision, recall or F1 between the retrieved and expected context lists, matched by normalised Levenshtein similarity.

retrieved.description: Context chunks the system retrieved; both lists ride on the options and the answer value is unused.

expected.description: Context chunks that should have been retrieved.

measure.description: Which figure the threshold is applied to.

similarity_threshold.description: Similarity at which two chunks count as the same chunk.

threshold.description: Score the answer must reach to pass.

graders.title: No PII
graders.description: Fails when the answer matches any selected PII pattern, using a conservative regex subset with checksum-valid cards and IBANs and international phone numbers only, not Presidio.

entities.description: Entity kinds to look for; absent means all seven, and an unknown name fails closed.

graders.title: Localization F1
graders.description: Scores cited files and line ranges against a gold localization set; file-level F1 and mean line-range overlap must both clear their thresholds.

reference.description: The gold localization set. The TypeScript grader object carries it here; the Python grade service reads the case reference instead.

file_threshold.description: File-level F1 the answer must reach; defaults to threshold.

line_threshold.description: Mean line-range overlap the answer must reach; defaults to threshold.

graders.title: Custom webhook
graders.description: Posts the answer to your endpoint — the url is SSRF-checked before the call and redirects are refused, not followed — and takes the verdict from a system Caveman does not control; a blocked url, a redirect, a transport error or a missing verdict fails.

url.description: Endpoint that receives the answer and returns {"passed": bool, "reason": string}.

timeout_s.description: Request timeout on the Python grade service; the TypeScript package uses its injected fetch instead.

graders.title: LLM judge
graders.description: Asks a judge model for a PASS or FAIL verdict against a rubric; an ambiguous or missing verdict fails.

gateway_url.description: Caveman gateway base URL the judge call goes through; the TypeScript package fails closed without it, the Python service falls back to $CAVE_GATEWAY_URL.

model.description: Judge model; pin it for any gate that uses a judge.

api_key.description: Gateway key for the judge call; leave unset to use the service environment.

upstream_key.description: Upstream provider key forwarded to the gateway.

subject_model.description: Model that produced the answer; the bias guard fails closed when it shares a family with the judge. The TypeScript package takes this from GradeDeps rather than options.

timeout_s.description: Judge-call timeout on the Python grade service; the TypeScript package uses its injected fetch instead.

graders.title: LLM score
graders.description: Asks a judge model to score the answer from 0.00 to 1.00 against a rubric and passes when the score reaches min_score.

rubric.description: What the judge should score against.

min_score.description: Score the answer must reach; the comparison is inclusive and runs on the unrounded value.

gateway_url.description: Caveman gateway base URL the judge call goes through; the TypeScript package fails closed without it, the Python service falls back to $CAVE_GATEWAY_URL.

model.description: Judge model; pin it for any gate that uses a judge.

api_key.description: Gateway key for the judge call; leave unset to use the service environment.

upstream_key.description: Upstream provider key forwarded to the gateway.

subject_model.description: Model that produced the answer; the bias guard fails closed when it shares a family with the judge. The TypeScript package takes this from GradeDeps rather than options.

timeout_s.description: Judge-call timeout on the Python grade service; the TypeScript package uses its injected fetch instead.

graders.title: LLM category
graders.description: Asks a judge model to put the answer in exactly one of your categories and passes when that category is one of the passing ones.

prompt.description: How the judge should classify the answer.

categories.description: The full category list, unique case-insensitively; the prompt lists them joined with a comma and a space.

passing_categories.description: Categories that count as a pass; every entry must be one of categories.

gateway_url.description: Caveman gateway base URL the judge call goes through; the TypeScript package fails closed without it, the Python service falls back to $CAVE_GATEWAY_URL.

model.description: Judge model; pin it for any gate that uses a judge.

api_key.description: Gateway key for the judge call; leave unset to use the service environment.

upstream_key.description: Upstream provider key forwarded to the gateway.

subject_model.description: Model that produced the answer; the bias guard fails closed when it shares a family with the judge. The TypeScript package takes this from GradeDeps rather than options.

timeout_s.description: Judge-call timeout on the Python grade service; the TypeScript package uses its injected fetch instead.

graders.title: LLM pairwise
graders.description: Asks a judge model to compare the answer against a baseline under both orderings, two judge calls, and passes only when the baseline never wins.

baseline.description: The response the answer is compared against.

criteria.description: What makes one response better than the other.

gateway_url.description: Caveman gateway base URL the judge call goes through; the TypeScript package fails closed without it, the Python service falls back to $CAVE_GATEWAY_URL.

model.description: Judge model; pin it for any gate that uses a judge.

api_key.description: Gateway key for the judge call; leave unset to use the service environment.

upstream_key.description: Upstream provider key forwarded to the gateway.

subject_model.description: Model that produced the answer; the bias guard fails closed when it shares a family with the judge. The TypeScript package takes this from GradeDeps rather than options.

timeout_s.description: Judge-call timeout on the Python grade service; the TypeScript package uses its injected fetch instead.

graders.title: LLM answer match
graders.description: Asks a judge model whether the answer conveys the same answer as the expected one, ignoring wording and formatting.

expected.description: The answer the response should convey.

gateway_url.description: Caveman gateway base URL the judge call goes through; the TypeScript package fails closed without it, the Python service falls back to $CAVE_GATEWAY_URL.

model.description: Judge model; pin it for any gate that uses a judge.

api_key.description: Gateway key for the judge call; leave unset to use the service environment.

upstream_key.description: Upstream provider key forwarded to the gateway.

subject_model.description: Model that produced the answer; the bias guard fails closed when it shares a family with the judge. The TypeScript package takes this from GradeDeps rather than options.

timeout_s.description: Judge-call timeout on the Python grade service; the TypeScript package uses its injected fetch instead.

graders.title: Semantic overlap (legacy)
graders.description: Legacy grader: Jaccard token overlap against the case reference, a heuristic and not an embedding model.

threshold.description: Token-overlap similarity the answer must reach; a non-numeric value fails closed.

graders.title: Custom predicate (legacy)
graders.description: Legacy grader: runs one caller-supplied predicate (regex, jsonpath or contains) carried in the case reference rather than in options.
